notes.title: The Achievement Update is here!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Here comes the Achievement Update!

We've been requested that feature a few times and so we brought it to life 😊

Achievements
There's currently 28 achievements for you to get in Anx!

 16 achievements for clearing each Campaign level with the the 3 Highscores goals
 3 achievements for reaching a specific wave in Endless Mode
 9 achievements that requires you to do something very specific in the game

PS: If you're an Achievement hunter, you can see all Achievements icons in the Steam Store page bellow to get some hints on those hidden  achievements!

Update Discount
To celebrate this update, we scheduled a -20% discount
This exclusive deal will be on from 
Jan 12, 7pm CEST (10am PST) to
Jan 21, 7pm CEST (10am PST), don't miss it out! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500450/Anx_Defense/

Patchnotes
V1.4.0.4
Apart from achievements, we also fixed and tweaked a few things after some player's feedbacks. 
Here's the patchnotes:

Features
 Added Achievements to the game
Tweaks
 Added and tweaked a few Visual Ambiances to make them more coherent (lighting/colors schemes in game).
 Tweaked Farms related tooltips to make the clearer and more accurate.
 Reduced sassiness of the "Shortcuts" Popup's button text. (sorry @McQueeb 😭)
 Removed FPS counter. 
PS: Steam provides its own FPS counter for those who would like to keep that feature. It can be found at Steam > Settings > In-Game.
Fixes
 Fixed a bug where the UI would get broken if a level was ended while holding a building.
 Fixed a bug where you could still send waves by hitting "Enter" after game Over or Won.
 Fixed a bug where Highscores would reset if set to zero.


Shoutout to Kantal
We really wanted to make a big shoutout to Kantal.
This update would probably never have seen the light of day without him.
Thank you so much!

You can check his games here 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158770/1BIT_CASTLE/ 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526870/Otherwar/


Thank you for reading,
And we wish you all a happy new year!

Liador & Nael

notes.title: ANX Defense Launches on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello there!
We're ✨so excited✨ to announce that the big day has finally arrived – ANX Defense is officially live on Steam!



💸 Launch Discount
Don't miss out on the -20% Launch Discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500450/Anx_Defense/



🧠 Your Thoughts Matter
ANX is a very novel idea. It's important to us to know what you think about it!
So please, share your thoughts with us 😊!
Your reviews and feedback are invaluable as we continue to evolve as a studio.


🙏 Thanks for the support!
A massive shoutout to all our playtesters and friends who have supported us along the way. 
ANX Defense wouldn't be what it is today without their dedication and enthusiasm ✨


🌟 Join the Community!
It'd be a great pleasure to see you over on our Discord and other socials. 
Here's the list and what to expect from each:

Discord (community, polls, feedbacks, playtesting)
Instagram (important news)
Twitter (memes, I'm learning humor so be patient please)
TikTok (what you'd expect from a TikTok account really)


🔀 What's Next?
This release marks the end of one chapter and the beginning of another.
Be part of the Nocteon journey if you're as intrigued as we are!😊


Thank you so much for being part of this.




With (a lot of) gratitude,

Jean & Nathan
Nocteon Games

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello folks! 
Nathan (Artist, Dev, 1/2 of Nocteon) here 😊
After 6 months of development, we can proudly announce the release date of our very first game!
This project was key for us to prove to ourselves that we could deliver a game 

The date
The game will release on ...
December 6th!
Central-Europe (CET): 5pm
West-Coast (PST): 10am
East-Coast (EST): 1pm
Russia (MSK): 9pm
China (CST): 2am
Japan (JST): 3am


Watch the trailer to get hyped about ANX's release and save the date!

[previewyoutube=S7ZiXMCa6mQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Full version features
We're really excited to announce the full release features! 
In the full version, you will be able to enjoy:

 the Endless Mode
 the full Campaign
 new Buildings (Damage Amplifier, Slow, Harvester, ...)
 a new Mana Condition Mechanic that makes Mana management much more intricate!


Thank you
Developing ANX has been a real pleasure as well as a very tough challenge. 
Being our first game, we needed to understand our capacity to deliver a full-featured game for our players.

Thanks for your support and all of your feedbacks, they've been absolutely key for us to move forward and focus on what's important during development!

We hope to see you fighting for you Nexus in ANX very soon!

Nathan
Artist & Developer
from Nocteon Games
